scientific_role: Apply the already-frozen IRIS adaptation metrics in one common scalar harness to the existing PABIM candidate and strong fixed/change-aware robust controls. This is development evidence only and cannot authorize confirmatory seeds by itself.

conditions.spikes: N(0,1) with iid 2% signed magnitude U(10,25) additive spikes
conditions.burst: N(0,1) with one length-10 signed magnitude 12 burst beginning at fixed index 1200 plus seed-dependent sign
conditions.regime: N(0,1), latent mean jumps 0->3 at index 2000
conditions.variance_shift: variance 1->25 at index 2000 with zero latent-mean change
conditions.mixed_shift_corruption: latent mean 0->3 at index 2000 plus iid 2% signed magnitude U(8,15) additive spikes

metrics.overall_mse: mean squared state error after burn
metrics.tail_mse: MSE on top 5% absolute observation-noise magnitudes after burn
metrics.TWMSE25: for persistent regime conditions only, mean(((m_t-mu_t)/D)^2) over t0..t0+24, D=max(|mu_post-mu_pre|,1e-8)
metrics.recovery: first t>=t0 with |m_j-mu_post|<=0.10*D for 5 consecutive samples; right-censored if absent
metrics.POST_MSE50PLUS: mean squared state error from t0+50 onward when eligible
metrics.false_open_rate: gate-open fraction after burn in conditions with no persistent mean change; not applicable for methods without gates

frozen_development_gate.clean_noninferiority: PABIM mean Gaussian MSE / Huber mean Gaussian MSE <= 1.05
frozen_development_gate.heavy_tail_information_gain: PABIM must improve mean MSE vs Huber by >=5% in at least two of student_t2, student_t3, contaminated, spikes, burst
frozen_development_gate.strong_robust_control_guardrail: Across those five adverse conditions, PABIM mean MSE may not exceed the mean of the per-condition best fixed robust control among Huber, HTAM, and student_t_matched_alpha by >5%
frozen_development_gate.persistent_shift_gate: On regime, PABIM must have TWMSE25 no worse than both Huber and confirmed_streak_huber AND recovery median no worse than both, with recovery fraction not lower by >0.10
frozen_development_gate.false_open_guardrail: PABIM mean false-open rate across gaussian, student_t2, contaminated, spikes, burst must be <=0.15
frozen_development_gate.verdict: PASS_DEVELOPMENT_GATE only if every criterion passes; otherwise NEGATIVE_OR_INCONCLUSIVE_DEVELOPMENT_GATE

no_retuning_rule: Run this exact configuration once. After observing results, do not change seeds, generators, method parameters, metrics, thresholds, or gate. Any successor is V2 with a new protocol.
promotion_boundary: This development result cannot establish IRIS novelty, external validity, submission readiness, or authorize reserved confirmatory seeds unless the separate successor-freeze requirements are satisfied.
